BiblicalUsage: Joktan is named 6 times in the Bible, and the passages here are Genesis 10:25; Genesis 10:26; 1 Chronicles 1:19. In Genesis 10:25 we read, "And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided..." It appears again in 1 Chronicles 1:19: "And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided..."
TheologicalSignificance: Joktan is never just a name, and I believe a real life stands behind it. The record keeps him, and I am glad it does.
